# S18 — Cross-repo inbox

Add adj inbox --all: list the open questions of every repo in the user repo list (adj repos, S38) in one inbox, each under its repo; plus two S38 follow-ups: XDG-correct path resolution and a lock for adj repos writes.

**Findings:** PROJECT.md Feature tiers (Later); Open decisions 6 · **Size:** M · **Tree:** cli

**2026-10-18** — 2026-10-18 from S38 (owner decisions at landing): also in S18: (1) a relative XDG_CONFIG_HOME counts as unset (fallback to HOME/.config), a relative HOME is an error, exit 1; (2) adj repos add/remove take a lock (store lock pattern: flock / LockFileEx on a lock file beside config.json) so concurrent runs cannot drop an entry. ## Why

Owner decisions 2026-10-18: the cross-repo inbox reads the repo list that adj repos manages (S38, internal/userconfig); adj inbox --all lists each repo's open records under the repo path; a listed repo that is missing, has no .adjudicate.json or cannot be read gets a warning on stderr naming it, the others are still listed, and the command exits 1 at the end. At S38's landing the owner also decided: a relative XDG_CONFIG_HOME counts as unset (XDG spec) and a relative HOME is an error (exit 1); adj repos add/remove take a lock so two concurrent runs cannot drop an entry. See the S38 note on this item for review lows.
